Printed page = PDF page - 6. Price band Rs 78-82, lot 182, fresh issue Rs 183.06 cr; anchor 28-Oct-2026, bid/issue 29-Oct to 2-Nov-2026.

1.finding: 3:1 bonus (08-Jul-2025) and the 9,00,091-share placement at Rs 88 (28-Oct-2025) are reflected: FY26 EPS Rs 7.64 is on 3,99,79,764 weighted shares; 4,05,00,091 shares now.

2.finding: Operating cash flow Rs 11.49 / 32.09 / 10.22 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 21.14 / 28.67 / 30.54 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT 67.0% while revenue grew 30% a year and inventory rose Rs 73.6 cr in FY26. Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 72.31 cr (PAT Rs 15.08 cr) as inventory was released.

3.finding: Current tax 19.6% of cumulative FY24-26 PBT plus deferred tax (accelerated depreciation on new lines); income tax paid Rs 21.14 cr over three years.

4.finding: Promoters and relatives lend the company Rs 20.55 cr (Jun-26) at interest (Rs 3.08 cr in FY26) and rent it premises (Rs 0.52 cr in FY26); managerial pay Rs 0.66 cr to three promoter directors in FY26. Disclosed and typical of a promoter-funded company.

5.finding: Amount-based fresh issue (Rs 183.06 cr): Rs 125 cr repays borrowings, Rs 15.77 cr buys out Siemens equipment leases, balance GCP (cap 25%). No fixed share count, so no objects floor.

8.finding: JSW Steel Coated Products supplied 86.65% of FY26 steel coils (85.13% in Q1 FY27); appliances 86.54% of FY26 product revenue; top customer (Amber Enterprises) 20.40% and top-10 71.33% of FY26 revenue. Typical of a service centre tied to one mill and the appliance PLI ecosystem.

9.finding: No contingent liabilities; capital commitments Rs 9.83 cr (Jun-26).

R2.finding: 25 delayed RoC filings over five years and a 2021 allotment to a promoter filed with the wrong form; adjudication application (06-Jan-2026) still pending before the RoC. Procedural; no penalty yet.

R3.finding: Monitoring agency appointed for the use of proceeds.

R6.finding: Smart Horizon Capital Advisors: track record of past issues not compiled in this run.

rationale.g1: Revenue Rs 755.26 / 1,055.71 / 1,266.82 cr FY24-26 (+39.8%, +20.0%); Q1 FY27 Rs 397.08 cr, ahead of the FY26 quarterly run-rate of Rs 316.70 cr in the AC season (p. 85). Installed capacity 4.62 lakh MTPA across four plants with 59-64% utilisation in slitting and cut-to-length (pp. 131-132), so growth needs little new capacity. Neutral 12% in FY27 then 8-10%; Bear 5%; Bull 20% then 10-15%.
rationale.m: Adjusted EBITDA (issuer KPI, net of other income) Rs 49.17 / 74.09 / 86.09 cr = 6.51% / 7.02% / 6.80% FY24-26 and 8.10% in Q1 FY27 (p. 131); reproduces from the P&L. Neutral 7.0% (three-year level); Bear 6.4%; Bull 8.0% (Q1 FY27).
rationale.nwc: Trade working capital 17.8% / 17.0% / 18.3% of revenue FY24-26 (p. 84); issuer NWC days 66 / 63 / 70 (p. 132). Neutral 18%.
rationale.capex: No IPO capex (the Rs 15.77 cr lease buy-out replaces lease liabilities, which are in net debt). FY26 capex Rs 54.80 cr was an expansion year (PPE Rs 1,183.24 m -> Rs 1,641.98 m), so the capex-per-rupee-of-growth factor implied from it is conservative. Net debt Rs 274.64 cr at Jun-26 = borrowings Rs 273.69 cr + leases Rs 13.03 cr - cash and bank Rs 12.07 cr (p. 84).

adjustments.reason: Subsidy of Rs 6.39 cr in FY24 (23% of PBT), Rs 1.00 cr in FY25, Rs 1.65 cr in FY26 and Rs 0.40 cr in Q1 FY27. Real cash, but scheme-based and time-bound; the scheme and its remaining tenure are not stated.

Mostly on margin-money deposits backing letters of credit for coil purchases, so tied to operations. Shown for information.

adjustments.reason: Not an accounting adjustment: the earnings after the issue repays Rs 125 cr of borrowings. For information.
